El dia sábado 13hs pasa a cargar combustible y hace fila de unos 20 autos aprox, faltando 8 autos entro el camión a descargar el combustible. Lo cual tardo 1:40hs. Bueno espere tranki mi turno. Cuando me atienden un señor Emilio valllejos con una mala onda, cara de c..... y muy soberbio prepotente ( no es la primera vez que me atienen asi) cuando fui a pagar los 17.mil de super. El se retira y vuelve a los 15minutos. Super prepotente. Muy mala atención pésima. Espero una respuesta o que hagan algo al respecto xque no soy el único que se a quejado de este señor. Saludos

(Translated by Google)
On Saturday at 1 PM, I went to get fuel and there was a line of about 20 cars. When there were only 8 cars left, the truck came in to unload the fuel, which took 1 hour and 40 minutes. I waited patiently for my turn. When I was attended to by a man named Emilio Vallejos, he was incredibly rude, had a sour face, and was very arrogant and overbearing (this isn't the first time I've been treated like this). When I went to pay the 17,000 pesos for premium gasoline, he left and came back 15 minutes later. He was extremely arrogant. The service was terrible. I expect a response or for something to be done about this because I'm not the only one who has complained about this man. Regards.
